difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 9.4.5 at source lines 588-594: for precategories A and B and a functor F : A -> B, being an equivalence of precategories is equivalent to being fully faithful and split essentially surjective. The author's proof (source lines 595-637) runs in both directions and neither is a citation. In the forward direction the inverse functor G together with the natural isomorphisms eta and epsilon is used to build an explicit inverse to the action of F on hom-sets and to verify the two inverse identities (lines 596-620), and split essential surjectivity is then read off from G using the component of eta at b (lines 620-630). In the converse, the object map of the inverse is given by the specified preimages and the morphism map must be manufactured by transporting along the hom-set equivalences that full faithfulness provides, after which both composite natural isomorphisms have to be checked (lines 630-637). The statement displays only the two equivalent types.
